title: Tarzan - Return to the Jungle
sources: own knowledge of the game (written in our own words)

widgets.text: Tarzan can run, jump, climb walls and ceilings, crawl through tunnels and swing on vines

Vine swing, spear throw, climbing
Weapons from the game's move set: spear and boomerang, plus thrown fruit
Ceiling climbing and wall climbing open routes above the main path

rows: fast sliding sections that need well-timed jumps

widgets.text:
Jungle bosses
Jungle animals and hunters guard each area; bosses close the chapters
Crawl under fast attacks, then strike from close range

Jungle levels
Jungle levels with vines, rivers, caves and treetops

Fruit (ammo), health
Fruit as ammo, health pickups, and the boomerang / spear when found

Hidden items
Hidden items above and below the main route
Look for hidden items above trees and below in caves

Levels cleared
Levels in order to the final chapter
Levels follow the jungle story; bosses end each chapter
